name: Document Creation
description: Reports, letters, manuals, proposals: structure, drafting and polish.
note: This is a document project. Agree the audience, purpose and length first, keep one consistent structure and tone, and deliver complete sections rather than outlines unless an outline is asked for.
details: For reports, letters, manuals and proposals. The agent agrees the audience, purpose and length with you first, keeps one structure and tone throughout, and delivers whole sections rather than fragments. The Tools list turns finished markdown into Word, PDF, HTML or an e-book (pandoc).
examples: A ten-page project proposal for a client
An operations manual with numbered procedures
A cover letter tailored to a job advertisement, exported to docx
A policy document with fixed section headings

tools.why: convert between Word, LibreOffice and PDF formats, and read macros
Markdown, Word, HTML and EPUB in both directions
pull the text out of a PDF
